newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end up, continue to trade in range.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end up, continue to trade in range.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended at the day's highs but failed to near resistance seen at 102.50 basis the spot-January contract.
Amid a dearth of fundamental news, activity is likely to remain muted until cold weather threatens the Florida citrus belt, market sources said.
The most-active January contract settled 1.25 cent a lb higher at 101.00, having ranged from 101.00 to 100.25. The back months finished 1.30 to 1.80 firmer.
